note: Countries are deep-reviewed in wave order. Each country has a tier (see 'tiers' and PROTOCOL §6) that sets how much fits in one run: a tier A country is a run on its own; otherwise a run takes tier B and C countries in order until 'run_budget' points are used (B=1, C=0.5), skipping over A countries, which get their own runs. Move a country up by editing the waves; move it between tiers by editing 'tiers'. 'done' records the date of its last deep review. 'retry' lists countries whose deep review was limited by blocked official sites (fewer than 3 readable records), for a later pass. 'thin' lists countries with a population over 20 million or a notable digital economy that ended a deep review with fewer than 10 records, for a longer catch-up pass after the backfill.

sweep_days.note: Daily sweep rotation (WEEKLY.md). Day 1 = Monday ... Day 7 = Sunday (ISO weekday, Asia/Riyadh). Workload = tier A 3, B 1, C 0.5; regional bodies 1 each. Each run sweeps only its day's group.
